narrationTexts: Confirmed the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Tax was computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, so any row with both a discount and a tax rate came out wrong. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
